text: We have been getting cockroaches in the kitchen for about a fortnight now. They come out from under the sink at night and there are droppings all over the shelves. My wife and I are both in our eighties and it is getting hard for us to keep pulling everything out to clean. Could someone come and spray please.

Tenant rang this morning to say the pipe out the back has burst and there is no water coming into the house at all. He is an older man living on his own and cannot get out there to shut anything off himself. Road in is still open at the moment but will not be once the rain starts.

Tenant reports she smelt gas in the kitchen when she went to light the stove this morning, and she has turned everything off at the bottle and opened the windows. She is pregnant and does not want to be inside while it smells like that. She asks for someone to come out as soon as the road lets them through.

The tap over the kitchen sink started dripping about a fortnight ago and now it runs a steady trickle no matter how hard we turn it off. The laundry one is doing the same thing. I'm seven months pregnant and getting under there to wrap a rag around it is hard work now, and our little one is always sitting in the wet patch on the floor. No rush, but we'd like it looked at before the road goes under in the wet.

Some of the roof sheets out the back have come loose and they bang and lift whenever the wind picks up. It started after that big blow a few weeks back. There's eleven of us in three bedrooms, my old mum and a baby among them, and the kids sleep in that back room right under it. Nothing has come through yet but we'd like it screwed down properly before the rain sets in.

Water been off at my place since yesterday arvo. I check the tap outside and nothing coming out, toilet won't flush either. Been carting water from next door but that no good for long. Can you send someone out, road still alright at the moment.
Front door lock busted, won't catch properly. Just me and my two grandkids here, youngest is four, and I am too old to be shoving furniture against it every night.
Ants right through the kitchen, in the cupboards and all over the bench. My partner is in a wheelchair and cannot get up to the top shelves to clear them out.
Toilet is blocked and backing up onto the floor, been like it since last night. One of us is on dialysis three days a week and cannot be dealing with that mess.

Light in the back bedroom keep flickering and sometimes it just go out altogether. The switch feel warm too when you touch it. My missus due with our first bub next month so we want it right before then. Whenever the sparky next come through is fine.

There was a loud bang from the powerpoint in the lounge and the whole board tripped. Now there are black scorch marks up the wall above it and the room smells like burnt plastic. We have left the power off at the main switch and nobody is touching it. Four of us live here and we all work, so someone can let a sparky in any time today.

A pipe has burst under the house and now there's no water coming out of any tap at all. We've had nothing since this morning, not for drinking, not for washing, not for the toilet. There's eleven of us here in a three-bedroom place, including my father who is getting on and a baby who needs bottles made up and bathing. We can't go the night like this.

Sparks come out of the kitchen powerpoint when my son plug the kettle in, and now that whole side of the house got no power. We turn it off at the box straight away. Seven of us living here, three generations, and we all crowding into the one room that still works. Need someone quick before something catch fire.
Half the powerpoints stopped working last night and the safety switch keeps tripping every time I reset it. Fridge and the hot water are on that side.

The sliding door off the lounge come off its track and now it don't lock or shut properly. We been leaving it open at night anyway because the tin roof holds all that heat in and there no shade trees round the place, but we don't feel right about it. Can someone come and fix the track this week.

The clothesline in the backyard bent right over and one end come away from the post. Been like that since the last big blow. I can still hang a few things on it but it sitting real low now. Whenever someone got time to have a look.

Tenant came into the office to report that the vinyl in the hallway has lifted and torn right across, and he keeps catching his foot on it. He says it got worse after the floor was wet and now a whole section curls up off the boards. He asks for someone to come out this week.

There is a slow leak under the bathroom basin that has been going a few weeks, and the cupboard floor has swelled up and gone mouldy. I have put a container under it and I empty that each day. My partner has bad asthma and the mould in there sets him right off, so we keep the door shut. I know the parts have to come across on the barge, so we are not expecting it tomorrow.

Hot water only lasting about two showers now, then it come out cold. Seven of us in the house and the baby not even one yet, so we boiling the kettle just to wash her. Been like this maybe two weeks. If someone can check the system when they get a chance.
Wasp nest the size of a football under the eaves right by the back door. Can't use that door at all now, they come at you soon as it opens.

Tenant came in this morning to report the front door has been forced and the lock is broken clean off, so the door will not shut or hold. She says there are eight people in the three-bedroom house including two babies, and she will not sleep there tonight with the door hanging open. Asking for someone on the next plane or barge if that can be arranged.

The air conditioner in the front room not working proper, it only blows warm air now. Been like that a couple of weeks. My grandfather he got a bad heart and this house gets real hot in the afternoon, nowhere cool for him to sit. We managing with a fan but someone should come and look at it when they can.

The toilet backed up two days ago and now the waste is coming up through the shower drain as well. The smell is right through the house and we can't use the toilet at all. My wife and I are both in our eighties and walking over to the neighbours of a night isn't easy for us. We know it's a plane trip in, but please get someone here soon.
Gutter on the carport side has pulled away from the roof and is hanging down. Not leaking into the house, just needs putting back up.

The drain out the side been blocking up and now dirty water sitting all over the yard where the little one plays. Toilet won't flush no more, we been using a bucket. My partner she got diabetes and she worried about that water sitting there. Road still open now, so if someone can come quick that would be good.

The water pump packed up a few days back and we've had no water in the house since. We can't wash or flush the toilet and we're carting drinking water in bottles. Our son lives with us and needs care every day, and keeping him clean is a big part of that. We'd really like someone out this week while the road is still holding.
Two of the hotplates on the stove have stopped heating. Oven still goes, so it's no drama, just cooking on one ring when I get in off nightshift.

Cold tap in the bathroom won't shut off properly, dripping all night. One of us is on dialysis three days a week so we like that room kept clean and dry, can someone have a look next time they're out this way.

Big section of roof sheeting has lifted off over the lounge and you can see daylight through it. House is like an oven by the afternoon with the sun coming straight in, needs doing before the rain comes.

No hot water coming out of the shower since the weekend, only cold. The heater out the back making a clicking noise but nothing happen after that. I can manage for now, but it would be good if someone have a look next time they come through.

Tenant came into the office in person to report the back screen door will not latch, the catch is bent and it swings open in the wind. He reports the main door still locks properly so the house is secure, he just wants the screen door fixed whenever a crew is in the area. Please arrange any contact through this office rather than by phone.

Something blocked in the sewer line, water come back up in the shower when I flush the toilet. Now the toilet not going down at all, so I got no way to use it. It been like this since yesterday and the smell getting bad. Can someone come today or tomorrow.

Pipe burst under the kitchen sink last night, water all through and I've had to shut the whole house off at the main. Just me and the two grandkids here, the youngest is four, and I'm too old to be dealing with this on my own.

Tenant rang this morning to say the toilet and the shower are both backing up and there is waste water pooling across the bathroom floor. She reports she is pregnant and has been told to keep out of that part of the house, so the family is using a relative's bathroom. There is no road in, so a crew will need to come on the plane or the barge.

We've got cockroaches right through the kitchen, in the cupboards and behind the stove. It's been building up for a month or so and the traps from the store aren't touching them. My brother-in-law is staying with us while he gets over his operation and he's sleeping on the couch in that room, so we're keeping it as clean as we can. Whenever a pest crew is coming through would be fine.

Power point in the kitchen made a loud bang and smoke come out of it. Now there's a black burn mark up the wall and that whole side of the house got no power. I turned it off at the box but I am too scared to put it back on. This one need someone quick, I know the crew got to fly in.

Tenant rang the office to report the laundry tap has been dripping for weeks and the tub is slow to drain away. She says she and her husband are both getting on in years and they have three little grandkids under six in the house, so the washing never stops. She says it can wait for the next crew that flies in, she just wants it on the list.

Power point in the kitchen been sparking when we plug the kettle in, and the lights right through the house went off twice last night before they come back on. My old father live here with us and he got a bad heart, he gets frightened when it happen. No road into here, everything come by barge or plane, so the sparky needs booking early.

The aircon in the lounge only blowing warm air now, been like that a week or so. It still make a noise but the room never cool down. My old father live with us and he got a heart condition, he sit in that room most of the day. We in town here so someone can drop in when they got time.

Tenant says the switchboard trips every time the washing machine runs, and last night the power stayed off for a few hours until it came back on its own. She reports she and her husband are both elderly and there are three grandchildren under six living with them. Road out there is unsealed and can close once the wet starts.

Tenant reports the outside tap has split and water has been running out of it all day, with the pressure inside dropping right off. He says one adult in the house is on dialysis for kidney disease and has to keep everything clean, so he wants it seen to quickly. Road in is unsealed and gets cut in the wet.
Sewage backing up in the shower and coming out the drain at the back. Smell is right through the house and we got a newborn baby in here.

No hot water out the tap for three days now, only cold coming through. Nine of us living in this house and two of them little ones not even five yet, so we boiling the kettle just to wash them. Everyone else waiting their turn with cold water. Road in is dirt so best come before the rain.

The back steps pulled away from the house on the weekend and now the whole lot wobbles when you stand on it. I am seven months pregnant so I have to hold the rail and come down sideways. My toddler goes out that way to play, so I have been keeping that door shut. There is no road in here, the carpenter has to come on the plane or the barge.

A couple of sheets on the roof have lifted at the edge and they rattle every time the wind picks up. No water has come in yet but there is a rust mark on the ceiling in the back room. My mother is elderly and lives here with me, and the noise wakes her up at night. We are in town so it should be easy for someone to have a look.

The pipe under the kitchen sink been leaking since yesterday and now the cupboard full of water. I turn it off at the front but it still drip out. Only me and my partner living here. Can someone come have a look this week.

Tenant says the front door lock has broken and the door will not stay shut, so she has been pushing a chair against it of a night. She reports she has newborn twins and a four year old inside and will not leave them in there while she hangs the washing. Road in is unsealed and can close in the wet.

Someone had a go at the back door last week and now the lock is busted, it just swings open on its own. There are eleven of us in this three bedroom house, three generations under the one roof. My grandmother is old and she sleeps in the room closest to that door, and there is a baby in the house as well. We are in town so I am hoping someone can get here quick.

Tenant reports she smelled gas in the kitchen when she went to light the stove this morning and has shut it off at the wall since. She says the house faces west and they have only fans, so it is stinking hot inside by the afternoon and she does not want to be in there with a gas smell. Both she and her husband are retired and home all day.
Back hotplate on the stove stopped working, other three still going. Only me here and I cook late after shift, so no rush on it. No road in either, whenever the barge or the plane suits.

Water is pouring out from under the front tap and running right across the yard, started sometime overnight. I have turned it down as far as it goes and it has not slowed at all. My father is elderly and lives here with me, and I do not want him walking out the front while it is like that. There is no road in to us, so it all has to come on the barge or the plane.

No water out of any tap since this morning, nothing in the kitchen or the bathroom. House cooks in the afternoon with the kids home and we got nothing to drink or wash with. No road in here either, only barge or plane.
Tap in the laundry snapped off and water spraying out everywhere, got a towel shoved on it. Seventies and on my own here, can't hold it much longer, and nothing gets in except by barge or plane.

The sewer pipe out the back broke open and it all coming up in the yard, right near the door. We can't use the toilet or the shower now and there is nowhere to wash the kids. My old father got a crook heart and he live here with us, he can't be walking past that. The road in is dirt but it dry at the moment, so a truck can still get through.

One of the power points in the bedroom stopped working, nothing come on when I plug the fan into it. The rest of the house alright. Just me living here and I am at the store most of the day, so any time after four suits me.

Tenant says the security screen on the front door has come off its hinges and will not lock, and she has been wedging it shut with a broom handle. She reports she is pregnant and is home on her own most of the day while the others are out, and she does not feel safe with the door like that. Road in is unsealed and closes once the rain sets in.

Tenant rang this one through as she does not write, and says the hot water system has been running lukewarm for a couple of weeks and goes cold halfway through a shower. She says they are managing for now and it can wait until a plumber is out this way. Road in is unsealed so she asked that it be looked at before the wet.
Tap out the front let go sometime through the night, now there's no water coming into the house at all. Nothing to wash up with before I head out on shift.

The kitchen tap been dripping long time now and the pressure gone right down. We got seven of us living here, three generations, so that tap going all day and all night. Not a big emergency but someone should come look when the road is open.
Clothes line out the back has come down, the whole thing is on the ground. One of us is on dialysis three days a week so there's a lot of washing, and nowhere to hang it now. No rush on it.

No water in the house since yesterday, pipe under the laundry let go. Old grandmother here with two little ones, the youngest only four, and nothing to drink or wash them with. Next barge is a while off too.
The front door lock broke off when I come home from work last night and now the door don't shut properly. I been putting a chair against it to keep it closed. Need someone to come fix it quick.
Taps run dry this morning, nothing in the kitchen or the bathroom. This place cooks by the afternoon and there's no cold water to drink to get through it.
Toilet's backed up and the drain outside is overflowing, can't use the bathroom at all. My partner uses a wheelchair and gets around slow, so this isn't something we can work our way around.

Hot water gone out two days back, only cold coming through the shower now. We got a two year old to bath and my husband he got diabetes, he needs to keep his feet clean and warm. Can someone come look at the hot water system.
Back door won't lock, the latch is busted clean out of the frame. Full house at the moment with family staying for the season, too many of us in here to leave it swinging open at night.

After the rain last week we noticed a wet patch spreading across the ceiling in the back bedroom. The sheeting looks like it's sagging a bit now. That's the room the little one sleeps in, and I'm seven months pregnant so I'm not climbing up there to have a look. It can wait for the next crew through, I just wanted it written down before the road shuts.
Wind took a sheet of roofing iron off over the lounge room and it's hanging by one edge. Rain comes straight in whenever it blows through.

The drain outside the laundry has been running slow for a couple of weeks and now the water just sits there after a wash. It's starting to smell, though nothing has come back up inside the house yet. Our youngest is eighteen months and crawls around out that way, so we keep having to move her off it. We can wait for the next crew on the barge.

The pipe under the house split yesterday afternoon and now nothing comes out of the taps. We've been carting water from next door in buckets since then. I'm seven months pregnant and lifting them is doing my back in, and the toddler needs drinks and washing all through the day. The road is still open if someone can get out to us.

Tenant rang this morning to say sewage is coming up through the shower drain and across the bathroom floor. She reports there is no working toilet in the house and they cannot use the bathroom at all. Asking for a plumber today.

Key snapped off in the laundry door lock. Still opens from the inside but it won't lock up now, and we got family staying for the season so that door gets used plenty. Whenever a crew is next coming through.

Tenant phoned to report a section of roof iron has lifted in the wind and water is coming into the front room. He says he has buckets down but the ceiling is staining up and the wet patch is spreading. Next crew flying in should take a look.
Cockroaches all through the kitchen cupboards, getting worse this last month. My partner's in a wheelchair and can't get down low to clean under there. Not a rush, but we'd like a spray done.

Someone kicked the front door in last night and now it don't close at all, just swings open. We got a two year old in here and my wife she got diabetes, all her medicine sitting on the bench. We can't stop here another night with the door like this.

The toilet started backing up on the weekend and now it won't flush at all. There's dirty water sitting on the bathroom floor and more coming out around the base. My father is elderly and he can't be walking through that to get to the toilet at night. We need someone out as soon as you can manage.

Tenant rang to say two of the hotplates on the stove have stopped working and the oven door won't sit shut. She reports the house holds the heat badly of an afternoon with only the fans, so they have been putting the cooking off until late in the evening. No rush from her end.

The power points in the kitchen been sparking when we plug the kettle in, and now that whole side of the house got no power. My little one is two and he crawling round there all the time. My husband got sugar diabetes and his medicine need to stay cold in the fridge. Road out here get cut when the rain come, so best you send someone before that.
Toilet backed up and there's sewage coming out on the ground outside. Stinks bad in the afternoon when the house heats right up, gets that hot inside we can't sit in it.
Drains all blocked up, no toilet and no water to the bathroom at all now. My partner is in a wheelchair and can't get out to the yard, so we're stuck here.

Tenant rang this morning to say a pipe has burst under the house and they have had no water since. She reports she and her husband are both in their seventies and are looking after three little grandkids, the youngest not yet walking properly. Nothing for washing and the toilet will not flush, so she is asking for a crew today.

Tenant says the front door lock has gone stiff and the key will not turn unless you lift the door up. She reports she is expecting a baby and cannot be shoving on the door like that. Not an emergency, she says, but she would like it looked at when a crew is coming through.

Woke up to water running down the hallway wall out of the bathroom. I turned it off at the main and it slowed, but it is still coming through and the wall and the floor are soaked. My wife has bad asthma and that damp smell in there sets her chest off already. Can someone come out before the whole wall goes mouldy?
Big branch come down across the back fence and the clothesline, whole lot is leaning into the yard now. We've got a newborn and I can't take the pram out that way.
Light in the second bedroom won't come on. Changed the globe, still nothing. No rush on it, we hardly use that room.

Tenant came in to the office to report the back door will not lock, the barrel just spins when you turn the key. They report they have been wedging a chair against it of a night. Asking for a crew out today so the house can be shut up properly.

The fridge stopped working a couple of nights back and everything in it gone off. My husband got diabetes and his medicine need to be kept cold, we got no way of doing that now. Baby is only two and we got nothing cold to give him. No road in here so it have to come on the barge or the plane, please don't leave it too long.

Tenant rang to say the toilet and the shower are both backing up and there is water pooling across the bathroom floor. He reports he is in his eighties and gets about slow with a walker, so a wet floor in there is a real worry for him. No road into the community, so a crew would need to come in by plane or barge.

Tenant says two of the hotplates have stopped heating and the oven door will not stay shut. She reports she is pregnant and is doing most of the cooking for the household on the one plate that still works. She is happy to wait for the next run of jobs.

Big patch of the ceiling in the front room come down and there more of it sagging, you can see daylight through the roof up there. Last time it rained the water come straight in on the floor. I'm an old lady and I can't be climbing up there to shift any of it. Someone need to come quick before the rest of it fall.
Bit of roof sheeting has lifted at the back corner, flaps about when the wind picks up. No leak yet. Worth doing before the wet comes though.

Tenant came into the office to report smoke coming out of the power board in the laundry and a burning smell right through the house. They have shut the whole place off at the main and are waiting outside. Needs a sparky straight away.

The sewer pipe out the back is blocked and it all coming up in the laundry and in the yard. Seven of us living here, three lots of family, and the one toilet we got don't work now. No water we can use for washing either. Nothing come in here except by barge or plane so please put it on the next one.

The front screen door don't shut proper, the catch is broke so it swing open on its own. My boy is two and he keep getting out that way. My missus got diabetes and she can't be chasing after him all day. Crew is only just down the road so maybe someone can drop in when they got time.
Hot water goes cold after about a minute in the shower. Only home late off shift, so any time through the day suits, I'll leave the side gate unlocked.

We got cockroaches real bad in the kitchen, they coming out of the cupboards and behind the stove every night. Termites too, there mud tracks running up the door frame in the hallway. We tried the spray from the shop but it not doing nothing. Can someone come in on the plane and treat the house?
No water at all in the house since last night, taps dry and the toilet won't flush. One of us is on dialysis three days a week and has to wash up before going in. Need it back on today.

The clothesline out the back come down last week and the wire is all bent up. We been hanging the washing over the fence since then. Not a big thing but be good if someone can have a look when they next come out this way. Road is still right now, it goes under later in the wet.

Two of the hotplates on the stove not working no more, only the little one at the back comes on. Hard to cook proper feed when my partner got diabetes and has to eat right. We got a two year old as well so I'm doing everything in the one frypan. No rush but we need it sorted.

Tenant rang this morning to say the sewer is backing up into the shower and the toilet will not flush at all. She reports there is no toilet or washing water in the house since yesterday and the smell is right through the place. She is pregnant and has asked for someone to come today.
Aircon dead since yesterday arvo. House is like an oven by the afternoon and the kids can't sleep in that heat.

About a week ago both power points in the back bedroom stopped working. We flicked everything back on at the switchboard and nothing changed. That is the room our son sleeps in, and he has a disability and needs care every day, so we are running an extension lead down the hallway for his gear. Can an electrician have a look sometime.

Tenant reports the laundry door has dropped off its top hinge and drags on the floor, so it will not shut. She says one adult in the house is on dialysis for kidney disease and the washing has to be done often. Happy to wait for a crew heading out that way, the road is open at the moment.

The lock on the front door not catching properly, you got to lift the door and push hard before it clicks. Been like that a fair while now. We got a little one, two years old, who can push that door open, and my partner got diabetes so we don't want to be worrying about it. Can someone come when the road is good.

Tenant phoned to say the oven door will not stay shut and the heat comes straight out, so she is only using the top burners. She reports she is pregnant and is cooking for the household most nights. She asked for a repair whenever it suits the crew.

The rangehood over the stove stopped pulling air about a fortnight ago, and now the kitchen fills with smoke whenever we fry anything. We open the windows and the back door but it just hangs around. My partner has bad asthma and the smoke sets it off, so we are cooking outside on the barbie most nights. It can wait for the next crew coming out.

Tenant called to report the ceiling fan in the main bedroom has stopped turning and the lounge aircon is only blowing warm air. She reports the house gets very hot through the afternoon and she has newborn twins and a four year old sleeping in that room. She says they are managing with the other fans for now but would like it looked at.

Tenant rang to say the sewer line is blocked and waste is coming up in the yard by the back steps, and the bathroom toilet and taps cannot be used. She reports there is nowhere in the house to wash or use a toilet at the moment, and she is pregnant. She says the road in is open but wet in patches.

Someone had a go at the back door last night and the lock is busted right out of the frame. The door just swings open now. We pushed the fridge across it but that not going to hold. We need it fixed today if you can.

Tenant phoned to say the air conditioner has stopped running and will not start from the remote or the wall switch. He reports he is elderly and does not get around easily, and he cannot manage the house without it. He asked for someone to come as soon as they can.

The front security screen was pulled off its hinges on the weekend and now the main door will not lock at all. There are eleven of us in a three bedroom house, so someone is always coming and going and that door never stays shut. My old mum sleeps in the front room and there is a baby in the house too. We need a lock on it quick smart.

Half the lights in the house have gone out, the kitchen and the hallway both, and the switches do nothing at all. It started after the storm about a fortnight back. Our son lives with us and has a disability that needs daily care, and the hallway is pitch black when we are moving him around at night. The road is open if a sparkie is heading this way.

Tenant reports the front steps have gone spongy and one of the boards has split right through. She says she is pregnant and is being careful on them going in and out. She asked for a carpenter next time one is in the community.

The flyscreen door at the back has come off its runner and sits open all the time. It has been sitting like that for a couple of weeks. Our youngest is only eighteen months and heads straight out that door the second we turn around. Not a big job, just needs doing before the road shuts.

Tenant reports the laundry drain is slow and water pools outside the back door before it soaks away. She says the smell gets strong of an afternoon when the house heats up, as they have only got fans and the place cops the full sun. Nothing is blocked inside, and she asked for it to be looked at when the barge next brings a crew.

There is a burning smell coming off the power point in the kitchen and it made a popping noise when we plugged the kettle in. We got nine people living here and two little ones under five running round that room all day. We turned it off at the box but half the kitchen is off now too. Can someone come and look at it today.

Tenant rang to say the letterbox is hanging off its post and the lid has come away. He reports he only moved in recently and it was already like that when he got the keys. He asked for it to be fixed whenever a handyman is in the area.

The pipe under the kitchen sink burst two nights ago and we had to shut the water off at the main to stop it. Since then there has been no water in the house at all, so we are carting buckets from next door for washing and for the toilet. I am seven months pregnant and we have still got a baby in nappies, so it is really hard going. The road in is still open now but it will be cut once the rain sets in.
Power point in the back bedroom stopped working. No sparks or anything, just dead.

The switchboard been making a buzzing noise and there is a burnt smell coming off it. We turned the power off at the box because we got scared it might catch. Whole house dark now. Road still open if you can come quick.

Tenant rang to say the laundry tap has been dripping steadily for a couple of weeks and the wall behind it is staying damp. She reports one adult in the house has kidney disease and she wants the washing area kept dry and usable. Says it can wait until a plumber is next through the community.

Tenant reports only two of the four hotplates on the stove are heating up, and one of those takes a long while to come on. He says he moved in about a month back and it has been like that the whole time. He is still managing to cook but would like it looked at.

The tap in the bathroom not turning off all the way, water keeps trickling out of it. Under that tin roof with no trees round the house it gets that hot inside, and we been going through a lot of water just keeping cool. Nothing flooding, just want it fixed when someone come out this way.

The toilet stopped flushing yesterday morning and now there is water pooling on the floor around the base. We have shut the tap behind it off, so there is no working toilet in the house at all. Three of us here and we are going next door to use theirs. Can someone come and have a look.

Someone come and tried the back door in the night and now the lock been broken, it don't catch at all. We pushed the table up against it but that door still swings open. My mother is old and she not sleeping with the door like that. Need it fixed today please.

Our hot water system started leaking out the bottom over the weekend and there is water spreading right across the laundry floor. It is coming out faster today and we cannot get it to stop. My partner has bad asthma and all that damp in the house sets her off. There is no road in here, so it would be the barge or the plane.

The aircon in the lounge is still blowing but it has gone warm, hardly any cool air out of it now. It has been getting worse over the last few weeks. I am seven months along and we have got a toddler who will not settle when the room stays hot. No rush, but we would like it seen to before the build up really kicks in.

The air conditioner packed it in completely a couple of nights ago and now it will not switch on at all. The house is holding the heat right through the night and nobody is sleeping. We have a relative staying with us who is still recovering from an operation and she is really feeling it. Everything comes in by barge or plane out here so I am letting you know early.

Half the power points in the house cut out yesterday and the switch on the board trips again every time we reset it. We have left it off for now because it will not hold. Hot water gone off two days ago, nothing but cold coming out the shower. I been pressing the button on the unit outside but it don't fire up at all. Only the two of us here and we been boiling the kettle to wash.

The sewer is backing up in the back yard, it smell real bad and there is water sitting near the door. Nine of us living in this house and the two little ones keep going out that way to play. The toilet inside is going down slow now too.

The main pipe under the house has burst and we've had to shut the water off at the meter, so nothing runs inside. Please get someone out to us.

The back door do not shut proper, the lock been broken since we move in. Our boy is two and he can push it open and get himself out the back. My partner got diabetes and he is the one home with him most days. Just need the lock fixed when someone is around.

Tenant says the pipe to the laundry has split and they have turned the water off at the mains, so nothing is running in the house. The flyscreen on the bedroom window been torn since we moved in and the mozzies get in all night. The window itself is stiff too and hard to pull across. My wife is having our first baby soon and she is not sleeping much as it is. Can someone put a new screen on when they got time.

Two of the hotplates on the stove have stopped working and the oven door won't stay shut. There are eleven of us in this house across three generations, so we're cooking for a crowd on the one plate. The sewer pipe out the back is blocked up and it come up through the shower drain. Now we got no toilet and no washing water in the house, everyone using the yard. Stove not working at all, no gas coming through, both hotplates dead. Got a newborn here and no way to boil water or warm her bottles.

Woke up this morning to water pouring out under the laundry and running down the hallway. We shut it off at the meter to stop it, so now there is no water at all in the house. Four of us live here and we all start work early, no shower and the toilet will not flush. The dirt road is open at the moment if someone can get out here.

The main pipe into the house split yesterday and we have had no water since. We are carting drinking water from next door and cannot flush the toilet or wash properly. My auntie is staying with us while she gets better after her operation and she has to keep her dressings clean. The road out here is dirt and it will only get worse once the rain sets in.

Tenant says the pipe under the kitchen sink has burst and they have had to turn the water off at the main, so nothing is running in the house. Asking for someone out today if there is anyone free.

Tenant says the drain outside the laundry runs slow and water sits in the yard for a day or two after they wash. Tenant rang to say the kitchen tap snapped off at the base and the water had to be shut at the meter, so the house has no water and the toilet will not flush. Tenant says the stove has stopped heating, all four hotplates and the oven are dead, and the point behind it made a popping noise. She reports she and her husband are both getting on and have three grandchildren under six staying, and they have been cooking everything on a barbecue plate outside. She is asking for it to be looked at quickly as there is no other way to cook a feed.

The hot water has been going cold halfway through a shower for about a fortnight. It comes good again after a few hours but there is never enough for the two of us. Nothing is leaking, it just will not hold the heat, so whenever a crew is next out this way is fine.
Big branch come down on the carport in the storm and the roof is sagging right over the doorway. I am seventy eight and on my own here, cannot get past it safely.

Toilet and shower both backing up, sewage coming up through the floor waste in the bathroom. Cannot use the toilet at all and my partner is in a wheelchair, no way of getting her to anyone else's place to wash.

There is a leak coming from the pipe behind the toilet and it has been running since last night. I have towels down but the floor stays wet and now the hallway is soaking up as well. No water in the house since last night, taps just spitting air and the toilet will not fill. Bub is only a few weeks old and we have run out of clean bottles.

The laundry tap has been dripping steady for a few weeks and the wall behind it is damp now. The washing machine hose fitting is loose as well and it sprays a bit while it fills. No rush on it, but if a crew is coming out this way it would be good to get it tightened up.

The front door lock been broken since the weekend and now the door don't shut properly at all. My missus got the sugar diabetes and she keeps her needles and her medicine in the house, we can't leave the place open like that. We got a two year old too and he can push that door open and get himself outside. Need someone to come and put a proper lock on it.

She is happy to wait for a regular booking as long as it gets done.

The pump packed it in two days back and now nothing comes out of the taps anywhere in the house. We are filling buckets off the tank at the back to flush the toilet and have a wash. The dirt road is still open but it will not be for long once the rains come.

Tenant says the front door won't lock - the key turns but the door still pushes open. Tenant and their partner are both elderly and have three grandchildren under six staying with them, and they don't feel right leaving the place open of a night. Asked for someone to come and have a look at it.

Tenant reports through the office that two of the powerpoints in the back bedroom have stopped working altogether. Tenant is deaf, so please don't try ringing the house - contact the office to arrange a time for the crew.

The hot water in the shower went cold on us a couple of days back and it hasn't come good since. Toilet blocked right up and the sink won't drain, sewage coming up in the yard. No toilet at all now, just me and my two grandkids, youngest is four, and I'm too old to be carting buckets.

Been getting cockroaches real bad in the kitchen, they come out from behind the cupboards soon as the light go off. Mice too, chewing at the bottom of the pantry door. No rush on it, just need someone come and spray when they got time.

Tenant reports two of the hotplates on the stove have stopped heating and the oven door won't stay shut. Tenant says there are eight people in the three-bedroom house including two babies, so they're cooking for a crowd on the one plate that still works. Asked for the stove to be looked at.

When the rain come heavy the water get in through the roof in the back room and run down the wall. That ceiling all stained now and sagging a bit. The light in the hallway stopped working about a week ago and we've changed the globe twice with no luck. The switch gets warm when you touch it, which we don't like the look of. My husband and I are both in our eighties and neither of us is steady enough on a chair to keep fiddling with it. We can manage with a lamp until someone gets out this way.

There was a burning smell coming off the switchboard yesterday evening and the power's been cutting in and out ever since. There's no road in here so we know it's the plane or the barge, but this one can't wait.

Half the house got no power since the storm come through. The bedrooms and the bathroom all dead, only the kitchen still working. Seven of us here, three generations, and everyone squeezing into the one room at night just to have a light. No road in, so you got to come by plane or barge.

The toilet been running non stop, day and night, and the cistern never fill up proper. Water going down quick because of it. I'm an old lady and my daughter can't reach round the back of it neither. Someone can come look when the road dry enough.

Two powerpoints in the back room stopped working sometime last week and we can't get anything to run off them. Drain outside the bathroom keeps backing up, smells bad and the water sits there for hours. Puddle's right across the ramp my partner uses with the wheelchair.

The air con in the lounge only blowing warm air now, been like that a while. Gets real hot in there of an afternoon and we got seven of us in the house, so everybody end up sitting in that one room. The baby not sleeping good with the heat. Can you send someone next time the crew coming this way.

The sewer pipe broke under the house and everything backing up, we can't use the toilet or the shower at all. No washing water for the kids neither. My grandfather is old and he got a bad heart, he can't be walking over to the neighbours every time. Road still open now but it won't be for much longer.

A fair bit of the roof sheeting over the back verandah lifted in the wind the other night and it's flapping about now. One sheet looks like it could come away altogether next time it blows up. Powerpoint in the lounge sparked and now half the house has no power. Can't charge the wheelchair and my wife's got a heart condition, she needs the fan going.

Tenant rang through this morning. She reports a sheet of roofing has lifted over the back bedroom, water is coming through the ceiling and the plaster is sagging. She has newborn twins and a four year old and has shifted them all into the lounge.

Only one hotplate on the stove working now. The other ones click but they don't heat up. I am a old lady and my daughter she do most of the cooking, but it take long time with one plate. No rush for this one.
Toilet's backed up and sewage coming up in the yard. No toilet and nothing to wash with now. House is boiling through the arvo with the kids home and the smell is bad. Next barge is a fair way off.
Laundry tap drips all the time and the kitchen one's the same. No emergency, but one of us is on dialysis three days a week so there's a lot of washing going through.

The back door won't lock properly anymore. It started sticking a couple of weeks back and now the latch doesn't catch at all, you have to pull it hard and it still swings open. We all work so there's usually nobody home during the day. Any weekday suits, the road in is alright at the moment.
No water coming out the taps since yesterday, only air. We can't wash or flush the toilet proper. My missus she is having our first baby real soon and she need to keep clean and drink plenty.

Cockroaches all through the kitchen cupboards, getting worse. Mice in the laundry too. My partner's got a chest condition and the dust in there sets it off, and the wheelchair can't get past it. No hurry, road out this way is rough anyway.

We started seeing cockroaches in the kitchen about a month ago and now they're in the bedroom as well. There's droppings behind the fridge so I reckon we've got mice too. My partner has bad asthma and all the dust from it gets her coughing. No great rush, but if a crew is coming out before the wet that'd be good.

There's a wasp nest right over the back steps. They came at my wife yesterday when she went out to the line and she nearly went over. We're both in our eighties and not steady on our feet, so we're using the front door now. This one needs doing quick before one of us gets stung.

The cold tap in the bathroom he only give a trickle now. Kitchen one not much better. This house get real hot in the arvo, tin roof and no trees, so the kids they want a cool shower when they get home. Not an emergency, someone can come when they got time.

The pipe under the kitchen sink burst the other night and we had to shut the water off at the main. So there's nothing running in the house now and we're carting buckets from next door. Our baby is eighteen months and we need water for her bottles and for washing her. Road in is open at the moment but that won't last once the rain sets in.

The hot tap in the bathroom has been dripping for a couple of months and now it runs steady no matter how hard you turn it. There's damp on the wall under the basin and the room smells musty. My partner's asthma is bad and that damp gets her coughing through the night. It can wait until a crew is next coming out our way.

Tenant phoned about the laundry tap, they say it won't shut off fully and drips into the trough all day. Says it's been like that since they picked up the keys. No water on the floor, happy to wait for the next crew run out this way.
Water pouring out from under the house and the yard's turning to mud. Been going a while now and I can't find any way to stop it.
Burning smell off the powerpoint in the lounge and the plate's gone brown around it. Shut it off at the board and we're staying out of that room. Road in is open if someone can get out.
Front security screen has come off its hinges, just hanging there. One of us goes in and out that way for dialysis three times a week, bit awkward getting past it. Whenever someone is out this way.

Bit of the eave lining has come away at the back corner and the gutter's sagging with it. Nothing leaking yet. House cops the sun all arvo as it is, so anything that keeps it cooler inside would help.

The glass in the oven door cracked while I was cooking tea last night. Now the whole front of it gets too hot to touch when it's on. We've got a little one, eighteen months, and she's into everything, I can't keep her out of the kitchen the whole time. We've stopped using it till someone can have a look.
Tenant rang this morning. She reports no hot water at all for two days and says the unit outside is knocking. She has newborn twins and a four year old and is boiling the kettle to bath them.

The toilet been backing up and now dirty water is coming out on the bathroom floor. We got nine people living here and two little ones under five crawling round near that mess. Can't use the toilet or the shower at all now, nothing working. Please send someone today.

Tenant rang to say the aircon in the main room has stopped blowing cold and the house gets very hot through the day. She reports the family is sitting outside in the shade most of the afternoon to keep cool. Any parts will need to come in on the barge or the plane.
Power point in the lounge stopped working, so the fan can't go on. House is like an oven by the afternoon.
Two of the hotplates on the stove not heating up no more. The other two still going so we been using them. If it needs a new part it got to come out on the barge.

The front door lock broke and now the door don't shut properly, it just swings open on its own. Seven of us in this house, all ages, and everyone's things are sitting there with the door open all night. Can someone come and put a new lock on quick.

There is sparks coming out of the switchboard when we turn the lights on, and it smells like something burning. My little one is two years old and she plays right there next to it. I got diabetes and my medicine has to stay cold in the fridge, so the power got to keep going. Road is still open at the moment if you can get out here.

Tenant says the tap over the kitchen sink drips all the time and the pipe under it has started to weep. She is expecting a baby and is finding it hard bending down to mop up the wet floor. She notes the road out may be cut once the rain sets in.

The front step has cracked right through and dropped away, so there is a big gap now you got to climb over. I carry my two year old in and out that way and I nearly went down with her this morning. I got diabetes and got to get to the clinic regular, and that step is the only way in the front. Road is still open so someone can come now.

We had a big blow through the other night and some of the roof sheeting lifted off over the back bedroom. Water came in through the ceiling and now the plaster is sagging and dripping. A relative is staying with us while they mend up after an operation, and that is the room they sleep in, so we have shifted them onto the couch. It needs looking at before the next rain.

Tenant reports the only air conditioner in the house has quit and the fans are not enough once the day heats up. She says there are eight people in the three bedrooms, including two babies who are not sleeping in the heat. She asks that a crew come out before the road goes under.
Small leak in the ceiling corner of the back room, only drips when it rains hard. That's where the baby sleeps so we've shifted the cot out.

The light in the bathroom keeps flickering and now it don't come on at all. I'm pregnant and up to the toilet a few times in the night, so I been using a torch. No big rush, but next time the plane brings a crew out can they have a look.

Tenant says the hot water system has gone out and the house has been washing in cold water for a couple of days. Tenant reports one adult here has kidney trouble and has been told by the clinic to keep clean and warm. Asks if a plumber can come in on the next plane.
Cockroaches all through the kitchen cupboards, worse of a night. I'm an old lady with two grandkids here, youngest only four, so I don't want spray left about where they can get it.

Tenant reports a section of the hallway ceiling has come away and is hanging down, and is worried the rest of it will drop. Tenant says one adult in the household is on treatment for kidney disease and cannot be lifting things or sleeping in the front room. Road out is rough already and will close once the wet sets in.

I can smell gas real strong in the kitchen when we go to light the stove, and now it smells even with it turned off. We shut it off at the bottle and we not cooking inside at all. I'm having a baby next month and I don't want to be breathing that. Need someone on the plane straight away.

Half the power points in the house gone dead and the safety switch keeps tripping off. When it trips the fridge goes off too and everything in there warms up. I been resetting it but it don't hold no more. Road is still passable if a sparkie can get out.

A car came through the side fence on the weekend and knocked two of the posts flat. The wire is down across the driveway now and we have to drive around it to get in. Nothing else got damaged, just the posts and the wire. It wants sorting before the road shuts for the wet.

The drain out the back is blocked up and the grey water is pooling in the yard where the kids play. Inside the shower won't drain and the toilet only goes down slow, so we been going next door to use theirs. Nine of us in here and two babies under five, so there is a lot of washing we can't do. Smells bad out the back too.
Pipe burst under the house, water's off to the whole place now. Newborn here and nothing to wash her with or make her bottle.

The air conditioner in the lounge stopped blowing cold about a week ago. It still runs but all it does is push the warm air around. My husband and I are both in our eighties and the afternoons are getting hard on us. Whenever someone is out this way next, could they have a look at it.

Tenant says the concrete step at the front door has broken away from the house and there is a big drop down to the ground now. She reports she is expecting a baby and does not want to risk a fall getting in and out. She says the road in has been cut twice already this wet, so she is asking for a crew before it closes again.
No hot water in the shower since two days ago. We turn the tap and it only run cold. Somebody said maybe the element gone in the tank. Can someone come look when they coming out this way.
Power point in the kitchen sparked and went black, smells like burning plastic. Got family staying for the season, twelve of us in the house, and half the lights are out now too.

Tenant says the stove has stopped working altogether and she cannot cook a feed or boil water for the two babies in the house. She reports there are eight people living in the three bedroom place and they have been buying takeaway since it went out. Asks for someone as soon as a crew is free.

Our hot water has been running out very quickly for the last fortnight. By the time the second one of us gets in the shower it has gone cold. We are both in our eighties and a cold shower is no good for old bones. No rush, but please put us on the list.

We have been seeing cockroaches in the kitchen cupboards for a couple of weeks. Last week there were droppings behind the fridge that look like mice to me. My wife and I are in our eighties and getting down on the floor to clean it all out is beyond us now. Could someone come and do a spray and put some baits down.
Clothesline post snapped off at the base, washing all over the ground. I am getting on in years and with a four year old in the house there is washing every single day.

Tenant says the lock on his front door will not turn any more and he has been leaving the house unlocked overnight. He reports he is elderly and does not get about well, so he cannot get out the door quickly if he needs to. Asks for someone today or tomorrow if a crew can be sent.

Tenant says the flyscreen door at the back has come off its runner and will not close properly any more. She reports she is pregnant and would rather have the door shut at night while she is resting. She is happy to wait for the next visit.

Tenant reports a section of the hallway ceiling has started to sag and there is a brown stain spreading across it. She says no water is coming through yet. She has newborn twins and a four year old at home and would like it looked at before the heavy rain sets in.

Two nights ago the lights in the back half of the house started flickering, and now the safety switch trips every time we put the kettle on. It has been getting worse each day. We have a toddler who wakes up in the dark, and I am seven months pregnant, so I am not keen on stumbling down the hallway. Can an electrician come this week please.

The power went off in the whole house yesterday afternoon and the switchboard is buzzing and smells hot. Our grown son lives with us and needs help every day, and we cannot manage any of that in a house with no power. There is no road in here, so whoever comes has to come by plane or on the barge. Please get someone moving as fast as you can.
Cockroaches all through the kitchen. Worst when I get home from shift in the middle of the night, they are everywhere on the bench. Need a spray next time the crew is on the barge.

We got mice in the kitchen and now they in the bedrooms too, chewing the food and leaving mess everywhere. Please send someone on the next plane.

The laundry tap has been dripping for about a month and now the pipe under the trough is leaking onto the floor. Tenant rang in to say the clothesline has fallen right over and the back gate is hanging off one hinge. He asked the office to write the report down for him as he does not read or write. He says it can wait until a crew is next out this way.

The screen door at the front will not latch any more and it swings open on its own. It started after the big wind last week. Our youngest is only eighteen months and she pushes straight through it and out into the yard. Could someone fix the catch next time they are out here.

The hot water has been lasting about ten minutes and then there is nothing, going on two weeks now. With eleven of us in the house across three generations, the water is cold long before everyone has washed. My father is old and the baby needs warm water for a bath. When the crew comes across on the barge, could they bring what they need to fix it.

Plenty ants coming in under the back door and right into the kitchen where we keep the food. They been getting worse since the rain start. We sweep them out and they come back the next day. Can someone come and spray while the road is still open?

A big storm came through the other night and now part of the roof over the back bedroom has come away. There's a gap you can see the sky through and water came in across the floor. I'm seven months pregnant and we've got a toddler crawling around in there, so we've shut that room off. Can someone come and look before the next big rain.
Power board sparked and burnt out, half the house has no power now. House is like an oven by lunchtime with no fans going.

Tenant rang to say two of the hotplates on her stove have stopped working and the oven door won't stay shut. She says she's managing on the one plate that still goes, but it's slow with the babies and the little one to feed. Road is alright at the moment so a crew could get in.

Tenant reports the front steps have pulled away from the house and one of them has broken through. She says she's carrying the twins in and out over it and her four year old has to step across the gap. She asked for someone before the wet sets in and the road shuts.
Back door lock is stuffed, won't turn with the key any more. Got a newborn in the house so we'd like it done when someone's next out this way.
Hot water's gone, only lukewarm out of the shower now. My partner is in a wheelchair and needs warm water for washing, so it's making things hard.
Powerpoint in the lounge is smoking and the lights keep cutting out. That's where the baby's bottle steriliser plugs in, can't use it.

The aircon in the bedroom, it only blowing warm air now. Been like that for a little while. My wife she pregnant and the baby coming soon, so we want that room cool for sleeping. Can someone have a look at it.

Tenant says the tap over the kitchen sink has been dripping steady for a couple of weeks and the cupboard underneath is going soft. She reports she is pregnant and finds it hard bending under there to keep emptying the bucket. Not an emergency, she said, but the road will close once the rain comes.
The toilet cistern it keep running all day and night, water just going. I turn the tap off behind it but then we got no flush. Nothing come in by barge for a while, so maybe bring the parts with you.
No hot water since yesterday, tank's cold. I work nights so best if someone comes in the afternoon.

Pipe under the kitchen sink has split and water is running out over the floor all day. I'm getting on in years and I've got two grandkids here, the little fella only four, and he's walking through it.

I noticed a wet patch in the laundry about a week back and it has got bigger since. Looks like the pipe behind the washing machine is weeping. Our aircon packed it in on the weekend and the fans aren't doing much. The house holds the heat right through the night now and it's been well over forty out there most afternoons. Sewer's backed up in the yard and the toilet won't drain at all, can't use it. I'm in my seventies here on my own and there's nowhere else to go.

Main pipe broke outside and now no water in the house at all, no tap, no shower. I'm an old fella with the heart trouble, and there's two grandkids here and my daughter too. We been carting buckets since it happen. Road still open but not for long I reckon.
