Pipe under the kitchen sink bust open and now we got no water anywhere in the house. I am an old man with a bad heart and I cannot be carrying buckets in from outside. My two grandkids stay here and they got nothing to wash with or drink. Need someone quick please.
Two power points in the kids room are dead, nothing works in them. House cooks in the arvo and the fan has got nowhere left to plug in.

Big wind come through last night and took half the roof sheets off over the back room. Water is running straight in and the ceiling is sagging down now. We are frightened it will drop on us. Road is boggy too so I don't know how anyone gets out here.

The back door don't lock anymore, the whole handle come off in my hand. There is seven of us in this house, five kids, and the baby sleeps in the room right beside that door. Anyone can walk in during the night. Please send someone to fix it.

Stove is not working at all, the hotplates stay cold and the oven too. We been cooking outside on a little camp burner but that is no good every night. My partner is pregnant and needs proper hot feed. Can someone come and look soon.

Tenant says one of the hotplates on the stove has stopped heating and the oven door no longer sits closed properly. She can still cook on the other plates so there is no hurry. She mentions one adult in the house has kidney disease and needs meals cooked at home.

Tenant rang to report the front door will not lock, the latch spins without catching. She is pregnant and says she does not feel safe sleeping with the door sitting open like that. Asks for someone on the next crew run out.

The drain outside the laundry is slow and it backs up a bit whenever the washing machine empties. Seven of us living here, three generations, so that machine is going all day and the water just sits there. Nothing is coming up inside yet but it is starting to smell. Someone can have a look when they come this way.

The air conditioner in the lounge stopped blowing cold a few days back and now it only rattles. My husband and I are both in our eighties and we feel it badly without it. We have a small fan going but it does not do much. We would be grateful if someone could come and look at it soon.

Tenant came in to the office to report the front screen door is hanging off one hinge and dragging on the floor. Message taken through the officer, as the tenant is deaf. The main door still locks, so they say it can wait for the next crew flight in.

Aircon in the main room has quit on us and the house is like an oven every afternoon. Tin roof and no trees out here, so it stays hot right through till night. The three kids cannot sleep and they are worn out for school. Crew is only up the road, can someone come.
Clothesline has pulled out of the ground, whole thing leaning over sideways. Can't dry the washing and we go through plenty of it with dialysis three days a week.
No power in the whole house, the board smells burnt and won't stay switched on. Someone here is on dialysis three days a week and we can't be sitting in the dark like this.

Water stopped coming out of all the taps yesterday and now the toilet will not flush. We been buying drinking water from the shop but we got nothing for washing or the dishes. Road is rough this time of year, but we need someone out here.

Tenant reports the sewer has backed up into the bathroom and the toilet cannot be used at all. She has newborn twins and a four year old in the house and is carrying water from a neighbour to wash them. Asks for a crew as soon as the road lets them through.

The power went out in half the house over the weekend and it has not come back on. The safety switch trips straight away every time we push it up. Our son has a disability and we care for him each day, and his room and the bathroom are both on that side with no lights. We need a sparky out quickly.

Tenant says the front gate has come off its hinges and is lying in the yard. There are six in the household, including one adult with kidney disease, but she confirms nothing is blocked and it can wait for a normal run.

The roof in the back room got a hole where the sheet come loose. Water been coming in when it rains hard, only a little bit but it wets the floor. I am an old lady now and my daughter cannot get up there to look at it. We been in this house a long time and the roof never done this before.

Tenant rang this morning to say two power points in the lounge have stopped working and the ceiling fan in the back bedroom only runs on the slow speed. She reports the house faces west and they have no aircon, only the fans, so the heat sits inside all afternoon. Road in is still open at the moment if a crew can get through.

No hot water coming out of any tap, been like that two days now. We got to wash in cold and boil the kettle for the dishes. This house got a tin roof and no trees for shade, so inside it stay real hot all day and half the night. We are a long way out here so we hoping someone can come quick.

Tenant phoned to say water is pouring out from under the kitchen sink and he cannot get the tap off at the wall. He reports the floor is already wet through to the hallway and the water is still running. He is an older gentleman who does not get around easily, so he cannot mop it up or reach the stop tap outside.

Tenant came in to report the toilet is blocked and dirty water comes up in the shower drain when it flushes. He says the toilet cannot be used at all now and there is nowhere else in the house to go. He only moved in recently and the road out that way is rough going at present.

Tenant came to the office to report the air conditioner in the main bedroom is blowing but not going cold anymore. She says it has been getting worse over the last few weeks and the unit rattles when it starts up. Report taken at the counter and written down here on her behalf.

Tenant came into the office to report the front door lock has broken and the door no longer stays shut. She reports she has been wedging a chair against it overnight and cannot lock the house up when she goes out. Report taken at the counter and written down on her behalf.
Aircon in the lounge not cooling, just blowing warm air around. Got a newborn in the house and we are trying to keep that room cool at night.

A big wind came through a couple of weeks back and lifted some of the roofing iron over the back bedroom. Since then you can see daylight through the gap and dust and rain get in. There are eleven of us in this three bedroom house, so that room has people sleeping in it every night, including my old father and my grandson who is still a baby. Nothing has fallen in yet but we would like it looked at before the big rains.

The air conditioner in the lounge stopped cooling about a week ago and now it only pushes warm air around. We shifted a fan in there but the room still gets very close by the afternoon. I am seven months pregnant and our little one will not sleep in that heat. It is a long drive out to us so we can wait a bit, we just want it booked in.

Last night the power board in the hallway started buzzing and the lights in two rooms went out. This morning there was a burnt smell around the switch, so we have turned that circuit off at the box. We have three little kids here and the youngest is eighteen months old and gets into everything. We are not turning it back on until someone has had a look at it.
Two hotplates on the stove have stopped working, only the little one still heats up. Full house at the moment with family staying for the season, so cooking for everyone takes half the night.
Clothesline has pulled out of the ground at one end and the line is sitting in the dirt. Only me here and I cannot lift it back up on my own.

We started hearing scratching in the ceiling about a fortnight ago and now there are droppings across the kitchen bench every morning. Something has chewed through a bag of rice in the cupboard and there are holes in the gyprock behind the fridge. All four of us work shifts, so the noise at night is no good either. Can someone come and sort it out soon, it is getting worse every week.
Light in the bathroom flickers and the laundry switch does nothing now. House cooks by the middle of the afternoon so we run the fans flat out, would be good to get the wiring checked.

Tenant reports a section of roofing iron over the verandah has come loose and is flapping about in the wind. He says one piece has already come down in the yard and the rest of it looks like going the same way. There is no road in here, so a crew and materials will need to come by barge or plane.

Tenant rang to report the ceiling in the main bedroom is sagging and a brown stain is spreading across it since the rain. She says the plaster has started flaking down onto the bed below. She has newborn twins and a four year old in the house and has moved the cots out of that room for now.

The hot water is not lasting the way it used to, it runs warm then turns cold partway through a shower. My husband has also noticed some rust staining down the outside of the tank. We are both in our eighties now and a cold shower knocks you about. There is no rush, we would just like someone to look at it.

The pipe under the house been leaking bad and now no water coming out of the taps at all. We got nothing for drinking or washing, only what we carry from next door. Just the two of us here but we cannot go on like this for long. Road is still open so someone can get through if they come soon.

Tenant reports the drain outside the laundry is slow and water pools on the ground for a day or two after the washing is done. She says it starts to smell once the sun gets on it. She is expecting a baby and would rather not be walking through it to hang the washing out.

Tenant says the front door lock will not turn with the key and she has been propping the door shut with a chair. Tenant reports it started not long after she moved in. The road out is dirt and gets cut off once the wet comes, so she asks if it can be looked at before then.

The laundry tap has been dripping steady for about a fortnight and now there is a wet patch spreading across the floor. We keep a towel down but it soaks through by the afternoon. I am seven months pregnant and our little one crawls around in there, so I would rather not have water sitting on the floor. Nothing falling apart, it just needs a plumber next time one is coming through.

Water pressure in the shower been low for a long time now, only a trickle coming out. Kitchen tap doing the same thing. I am getting on in years and I got trouble with my heart, so I cannot be crawling round under the house checking pipes myself. Grandkids still get washed, just takes a long time.

The air conditioner in the lounge stopped blowing cold on the weekend and now it will not switch on at all. The house holds the heat right through the night and none of us are sleeping. I have washed the filter and checked the power point and it made no difference. There are two teenagers here and we are all sitting out in the yard of an evening.

Aircon in the bedroom making a loud rattle and the air not coming out cold like it used to. It still go, but that room stay hot all through the afternoon. I got our first baby coming soon and I feel the heat real bad in there at night. No rush, but someone should have a look at it.

Tenant rang to say no water is coming out of any tap in the house since yesterday morning and the toilet will not flush. Tenant reports they are carting buckets from a neighbour to drink and to wash. Officer note: tenant does not read or write so please ring this office rather than post a letter, and there is no road in, so a plumber comes by plane or waits on the barge.

A pipe under the kitchen sink let go a couple of nights ago and water runs out onto the floor every time the tap is turned on. We have shut the water off at the mains and we are washing up in the laundry tub. My husband and I are both in our eighties and neither of us can get down under there to see what has broken. We would be grateful for someone soon, before the cupboard is ruined.

Tenant reports that only one hotplate on the stove is working and the oven door no longer sits shut. Tenant says she has been cooking outside on the barbecue plate instead. Nothing else reported wrong with the house.

Tenant reports the back door has been forced and will not lock at all now, it swings open on its own. She says she is pregnant and does not feel right sleeping in the house with the door like that. Tenant has jammed a chair against it for tonight and is asking for someone today.

Our split system packed it in a few days back, no cold air at all, just a fan noise. Inside the house is like an oven by the middle of the day. I have had the doors open and two pedestal fans going and it does not touch it. The road in is dirt and already getting soft with the rain, so the sooner a crew gets out the better.

The aircon in the front room still cools but it drips water onto the carpet the whole time it runs. We have a bucket under it which does the job for now. We are both in our eighties and would rather not be climbing up to that thing. No hurry, just whenever a crew is next out this way and the road lets them through.

Tenant reports the clothesline has come away from its post and the line is lying on the ground. Tenant asks for it to be put back up as the washing has nowhere to hang. Officer note: tenant is deaf, so all contact to come through this office and not by calling the house.

The power point in the kitchen sparked and left a black mark on the wall, and now there is a burning smell when we turn the light on. We switched that one off at the box and we not using that room. Seven of us living here, three generations, so there is nowhere else for everyone to sit and cook. Please send someone quick, we frightened of a fire starting.
Sewage coming up out of the drain into the back yard, the whole place stinks. I am an elderly woman with two grandkids here and the youngest is only four, plays right out there.

Last night all the lights went off and when they come back the switchboard was clicking and smelling hot. Now half the house got no power and we too scared to turn anything on. We got five kids in here plus us two, the baby not even one year old, and the house is full right up. Someone need to come today, this one is not safe.
Screen door on the front has no fly wire left in it, all torn out. Mozzies getting inside of a night.

A bit of the roof sheeting over the verandah has lifted and it bangs about whenever the wind comes through. It started after that big blow a couple of weeks back. No water coming in yet, but I reckon it will once the proper rain sets in. Our youngest is eighteen months and toddles around out there, so I do not want that sheet coming down.

No hot water in the house since the weekend, the unit out the back is stone cold and there is a puddle sitting under it. Four of us share this place and we are all up early for work, so we have been having cold showers. I switched it off and on again at the box and nothing changed. Can someone get out and look at it this week please.
Hot water gone completely, only cold coming out of the shower. I am in my seventies and on my own here, cannot be washing in cold water like this.

The hallway ceiling has a brown stain spreading across it and the plaster is starting to sag a bit. I first noticed it after the rain came through last week. It is not dripping, but something above must be letting water in. Happy to wait for an appointment, I just want it sorted before the wet really starts.

Tenant rang in about cockroaches, says they are all through the kitchen cupboards and come out over the benches at night. They report the spray from the store knocks them down for a day or two and then they are back again. Asks for someone to come on the next barge and do the whole house properly.

Tenant came into the office to report the roof. She says a sheet of roofing iron has lifted at the back corner and is flapping about in the wind, and water came through the ceiling in the last storm. Tenant is deaf and spoke through the housing officer, and asks for someone before the next big blow.

Tenant says the toilet and the shower are both backing up and there is dirty water sitting in the yard now. She reports the smell is through the whole house, and with only fans in there and the sun on that side all afternoon they cannot shut the place up. Asks for a plumber today if there is one going.
Aircon in the lounge only blowing warm air, not cooling at all. My partner uses a wheelchair and cops the heat badly, and the road out here shuts once the rain sets in.

Tenant says the front door lock has broken and the door only stays shut with a bit of rope tied round the handle. He reports there are six of them in the house and one adult with kidney sickness, and he wants the door shutting properly at night. Not an emergency, but asks for it to go on the list for the next crew flying in.

Tenant rang this morning about the roof over the back bedroom. She says the ceiling has sagged and is dripping onto the bed after the rain, and her two newborn babies and her four year old sleep in that room. She is asking for someone on the next plane before the next lot of rain comes through.

Tenant came to the office about the back door, says it has been forced and will not lock at all now. He reports it is just the two of them, both getting on in years, with three little grandkids staying in the house. Road is still open and he is asking for someone quickly before the rain sets in.

The power points in the kitchen and the front room not working since last week. We got nine people living in this house and two little kids, so everyone is using the one powerpoint in the hallway for everything. Nothing burning or sparking, but we need it fixed when the crew come over on the barge.

Tenant says the kitchen cupboard doors have come off their hinges and the cupboard under the bench has collapsed on one side. She reports she is washing bottles for her two babies and feeding a four year old all day, and she has nowhere clean to put anything. Happy to wait for the next crew coming in on the plane.

The toilet started backing up on the weekend and by last night it was coming up through the shower drain as well. We had a go with the plunger and a bit of wire and nothing shifted it. Now there is dirty water pooling under the house and the smell is terrible. Four of us live here and we are all at work in the day, but a crew can come any time and we will leave it unlocked.

The front screen door been broken for a while now, the lock don't catch at all. Seven of us living here, three lots of family in the one house, and people going in and out all day so that door cops it. Can someone come and have a look at it when they get a chance.

The back door handle came off in the wind the other night and now the door will not lock at all. Our son has a disability and needs help every day, and the carer comes through that door. Anyone could walk straight in while we are asleep. We would like it sorted before the road goes under.

The sewer pipe outside busted open and it running into the yard where the kids play. We got no toilet working now and no water coming out of the shower or the laundry tap. Seven of us in this house, five kids and the baby not one year old yet, and we been going next door to use their toilet since last night. Please send someone today, the road still open.

The aircon in the front room stopped cooling about a week back and now it just rattles away. Our son has a disability and he sits in that room most of the day, and he does not cope once it heats up in there. We have got a fan on him for now. No rush, but before the wet really gets going would be good.

Big wind last night took half the roof off the back of the house. The ceiling come down in the bedroom and the rain coming straight in, I can see sky from inside. I been sleeping on the lounge but the water getting in there too now. Need someone out here quick, road still open for the moment.
Sewage backing up into the shower and all over the bathroom floor. Partner uses a wheelchair and cannot get through that wet floor at all.

Our bedroom aircon packed it in at the start of the week and only the fan part works now. The house takes the sun all afternoon and it is stinking hot inside by the evening. I am seven months pregnant and we have a toddler, and none of us are sleeping in that heat. We know we are a long way out, but if a crew is heading this way could they have a look.

The powerpoint in the kitchen been sparking and it gone black round the plug, we could smell burning. We switched it off at the box but half the lights went off with it. Nine of us in here with two little ones crawling about, and I don't want them anywhere near it. Can someone come and check that wiring please.
Mice in the kitchen, chewing through everything in the cupboard. Old fella here on my own, can't be climbing round setting traps.

Tenant rang, says two of the hotplates on the stove have stopped working and the last one sparks when he turns the knob. He is an older man living on his own and does not get about easily, so he has been on bread and tinned food with nothing to cook on. Asks for the stove to be looked at as soon as a crew can fly in.

Two of the hotplates on the stove stopped heating up last week, and the oven takes ages to get going. We are both in our eighties and we cook every meal at home, so it is making things hard. No rush, but we would like it looked at. The road out here gets cut once the rain sets in, so earlier is better than later.

The roof over the back room is sagging a bit and there is a gap where the sheet come loose. When the wind blow you can hear it rattling up there. We got seven of us living here, three generations, and that back room is where the kids sleep. Can someone come have a look.

The front door lock has gone stiff and now the key only turns halfway. I have to lift the door up to get it to shut properly. My father lives with me and he is getting on, and he cannot manage that door at all any more. Nobody has tried to get in, it just needs fixing when someone is free.
Cockroaches in the kitchen cupboards, heaps of them. Been getting worse the last couple of weeks.

Tenant rang this morning to report ants and cockroaches through the kitchen and the laundry. She says she and her husband are both elderly and they have three little grandkids under six staying with them, and she is finding the roaches in the kids' room now. Asked for pest control to come out when they can.

Hot water has been running lukewarm for about a fortnight and now it goes cold after one shower. There are four of us here and we all start work early, so we are queuing up of a morning. The unit out the back makes a knocking noise when it kicks in. Happy to wait for the next run out this way.

Tenant phoned to say there were sparks and a burning smell out of the powerpoint in his lounge room, and the lights on that side of the house have gone out. He is elderly and lives on his own, and he says he cannot get out the back to the meter box to switch anything off. He has been told to stay out of that room until someone comes.

The drain outside the laundry has been backing up slowly for a few weeks and there is a wet patch and a smell in the yard now. It clears itself after a while, so we are managing alright. Our son lives with us and needs care every day, and that means a lot of washing going through. Whenever a crew is next coming this way would suit us.

Tenant reports that half the powerpoints in the house stopped working two nights ago and the safety switch keeps tripping whenever anything is plugged in at the kitchen bench. She says one of the adults in the house is on dialysis and there are six people relying on that fridge for their food. She has asked for someone out this week.

The light in the hallway and the one in the back bedroom don't work no more, we changed the globes and still nothing. There is seven of us in this house so them rooms get used all night. The powerpoint next to it is still going alright. No hurry, just put us on the list.

Tap in the bathroom been dripping since the start of the month and now it don't stop at all. The washer must be gone. Water running down that drain all day and all night. Any time suits me, I work days.

Tenant rang to say the hot water system has stopped altogether and there has been nothing but cold out of every tap since yesterday morning. She reports she has newborn twins and a four year old at home, and she is boiling the kettle to bath them. She asked for someone as soon as a crew can get out this way.

Tenant called to say the air conditioner in the lounge is blowing warm air only and has been like that since the weekend. She reports the house faces west and they have nothing but fans now, and it is getting well over forty inside of an afternoon with the build-up. She asked for someone quickly because they cannot cool the place down at all.
Mice in the kitchen again, droppings all over the bench every morning. I am in my seventies and on my own here, so I cannot be chasing them about.

The sewer has come up in the yard and now it is coming back into the shower, and the toilet won't flush at all. We can't use no water in the house, can't wash, can't do nothing. My grandfather lives here, he is old and he got a crook heart, and the smell is right through the place. Someone got to come today, the road is still open but it won't be after the next rain.

There is a wasp nest right by the back door and they are getting inside through the kitchen window. Two of us copped a sting yesterday bringing the washing in. My aunty is staying with us while she recovers from her operation and she cannot get past that door on her own. Please send someone this week.
Sheets of roofing iron lifting on the western side, couple of screws gone. House cops the sun all afternoon and it is like an oven inside with that gap letting the heat straight in.

Tenant rang to say the sewer is overflowing into the laundry and out into the yard, and they have had to shut the water off at the house so nothing is running now. She reports she and her husband are both elderly and there are three grandchildren under six with them, and they have no toilet and no way to wash the little ones. She has asked for a crew today and says the road in is still passable.

Someone tried the back door overnight and now the frame is split and the lock will not catch at all. We have had to shove a chair against it to keep it shut. My mum lives with me, she is elderly and she has not slept since it happened. I know we are a long way out, but this needs making secure quickly.
Screen door off its runner and the handle on the front door come away in my hand. Full house at the moment with family staying for the season, so that door is going all day.
Stove is dead, nothing turns on at all. Was going dodgy for a while and now I can't cook a feed.

Tenant rang to say the sewer is backing up into the laundry and out the back door. She reports the toilet cannot be used and there is no clean water in the house for washing. One adult in the home has kidney disease and she is worried about the health side of it.
Aircon in the lounge only blows warm air. House cooks up by the afternoon and we end up sitting out the back till dark.
Drain out the back has come up and the toilet won't flush, nothing goes down. No showering or washing here, and there's a mob of us in the house with family staying for the season.

One of the hot plates not working proper, only the little one heats up. We got a lot of people in this house and a baby needing her bottle warmed, so cooking takes long time now. Oven still going alright.

The air con unit making a bad noise and only pushing out warm air. My little two year old gets real cranky in the heat, and my partner got sugar diabetes so he feels it bad when the house stay hot like this. I know the part gotta come in on the barge, we just waiting.

Tenant says there are cockroaches through the kitchen cupboards and something running in the roof of a night. He is an older man and does not get around easy, so he cannot clear the cupboards out himself. Asking for a pest treatment as soon as someone can come.

Tenant rang through, the sewer has blocked and it is coming up in the yard where the little ones play. She reports she and her husband are both getting on in years and have three small grandchildren in their care, so they cannot keep them away from it. Nothing comes in by road here, so she is asking for the next plane or barge.

The power board in the hallway sparked and there was a burning smell, now half the house got no power. We shut it off at the main switch because I got frightened of a fire. My missus is having our first baby real soon and we can't be living like this. Nothing comes here by road so please send someone on the plane.

A big piece of the hallway ceiling come down after the rain and more of it looking ready to fall. We got five kids in here, the baby crawls round that way, and plenty of family sleeping in the front room too. Can someone come and look at it quick.

Tenant reports the kitchen tap drips all the time and reckons the washer has gone. He says he can still use the sink but the noise keeps him awake. He is elderly and would rather not get under there himself.

The air conditioner in the main bedroom stopped cooling about a week back. It still runs but the air coming out of it is warm. My cousin is staying with us while he gets over an operation, and he needs to rest up in that room. The road in is open at the moment so it would be a good time to get out here before the wet.

The pipe under the house burst and now we got no water out of any tap. My mum is an old lady and she can't wash herself or make a cup of tea, we been carting buckets from next door. Road still open for now, so hoping someone can come.
Front door lock won't catch, have to pull it hard and it still swings open. Work nights so the place sits empty and I'd rather it locked up properly.
No water in the house since this morning, taps dry and the toilet won't fill. Mains seem fine outside so it must be something on our side.
Stove not heating at all, hot plates and oven both. One fella here is on dialysis three days a week and needs proper cooked meals, can't be living on takeaway.

Toilet blocked up and the drain outside is overflowing, so no bathroom or shower for us. I'm an old girl looking after my two grandkids, the littlest only four, and I don't want them anywhere near it.
Aircon has packed it in, no air coming out of the unit at all. My husband uses a wheelchair and can't just get up and move somewhere cooler.

Hot water system has gone, only cold coming through the taps. One of us is on dialysis three days a week and needs a hot wash, and boiling the kettle isn't cutting it. Road's alright at the moment if someone can head out.

The air conditioner cut out yesterday afternoon and has not come back on. There is no light on the unit at all and the house heats right up inside. Our son lives with us, he has a disability and needs care every day, and he cannot cope when it gets this hot. We would be grateful if someone could come and look at it soon.

Stove not working now. Two of the hotplates gone dead and the last one only just warms up. I'm an old woman and I can't be cooking proper feed for me and my daughter like this. Road might close when the rain comes so best you send someone before that.

The tap over the laundry trough started dripping about a week back and now it runs a steady trickle we can't shut off. It's not flooding anything, it just goes down the trough. I'm seven months pregnant and our little one is into everything, so I'd like it sorted before the wet really sets in. The road out here can shut for a while once the rain starts.

The aircon in the lounge room has stopped blowing cold, it just pushes warm air around now. It's been like that for a few days. The fans still work so we're getting by, but the baby is only eighteen months and doesn't sleep in this heat. There's no road in here, so whenever the part comes over on the barge is fine by us.
Kitchen tap dripping non stop, been like it a couple of weeks. One of us is on dialysis three days a week so we like to keep that bench clean, no big rush though.

The back door lock is broken, the key just spins around and don't catch. We can still shut the door, we been putting a chair against it of a night. There's seven of us in this house and the baby not even one yet, so the little ones get out that door easy. Whenever the truck can get out this way is alright.

The toilet backed up yesterday and now there's sewage coming up through the shower drain too. We've shut the bathroom door and stopped using it, so there's no working toilet or shower in the house at all. The smell is right through the place now. We're all out at work but someone can meet the crew any time, and the road is alright at the moment.

No hot water at all since yesterday morning, the tank is stone cold and there's water pooling under it. We've switched it off at the wall. One of us has bad asthma and washing in cold water sets the wheezing off straight away, so we can't just wear it. It's a long way out here and the road gets cut about once the rain comes.

The air conditioner in the back bedroom runs but barely cools, and it rattles hard when it kicks in. It's been getting worse over the last fortnight. That's my elderly mother's room and she feels the heat badly, so I've put a fan in there for now. No emergency, we'd just like it looked at before it gets any hotter.

Hot water's gone funny, it runs hot for a couple of minutes then turns cold again. Been doing that about a week. We can still shower if we're quick about it. No rush, just want someone to have a look when they're round.

There's a wasp nest built up under the carport right where we park, and they come inside every time the door opens. It's got a lot bigger over the last week. One of us has bad asthma and the spray you'd use on them sets the wheezing off, so we're not game to touch it ourselves. Can someone come and deal with it soon please.

There's a patch of the hallway ceiling gone brown and soft, looks like the roof is letting water in somewhere above it. It shows up after heavy rain and dries out again after. Nothing is falling down yet, but one of us has bad asthma and I don't want mould coming through once the wet sets in. Happy to wait until a crew is out this way.

The hot water system has packed it in, nothing but cold out of every tap since last night. There's nothing to wash with and the nights have turned cool again. One of us has bad asthma and a cold shower knocks the wind out of them straight off. Everything comes in by barge or plane here, so if a part is needed can it go on the next one.

Tenant rang the office to say the front screen door won't latch, the catch is bent and it swings open in any wind. Tenant says the timber door behind it still locks properly so the house is secure overnight. Tenant asks to be rung rather than sent a letter, and is happy for a crew to call in any weekday.

The drain outside the laundry has been running slow for a couple of weeks and now dirty water sits on the concrete after every wash. It does soak away eventually. Our toddler plays out that side of the house and I'm seven months pregnant, so I'd rather not be scrubbing it myself. It's not an emergency, it just needs clearing when someone is about.

Tenant came in to the office to report the powerpoint next to the fridge is sparking, with black marks up the wall above it and a smell of hot plastic. Tenant has turned the power off at the board and is keeping out of that part of the house. Tenant is deaf and speaks through this office, so please contact us here to arrange access, and note the road in is unsealed.

The toilet cistern keeps running after you flush it, it don't stop unless you jiggle the handle. Been going like that for a good while now. It's not leaking on the floor or nothing. Just put us on the list for next time a plumber comes through.
Aircon in the front room only blowing warm, about a week now. One of us is on dialysis three days a week and the heat knocks them around, so put us down for a look when a crew is out this way.

No water coming out of any tap in the house since this morning, not even a trickle. There's seven of us living here, three generations, and we can't wash or cook or flush the toilet. We been carting buckets from next door all day. Please send someone quick as you can.

Tenant reports the sewer has blocked and is overflowing at the gully trap by the back steps, and the toilet cannot be used at all. Tenant says eight people live in the three-bedroom house including two babies, and they are going next door to use a toilet and to fill water containers. Road in is unsealed but open at present, and tenant is asking for a crew today.

The toilet blocked up yesterday afternoon and now it's backing up into the shower recess. I've had a go with the plunger and it made no difference at all. The only toilet in the house is out of action and we can't use the shower either. Can someone please come today.

Call taken through the housing officer as the tenant is deaf. Tenant says the front door lock is sticking and the key will not turn from the outside. She reports she has to shoulder the door to get it to catch properly.
Kitchen tap dripping non stop and getting worse. Got the extended family staying for the season so there's a mob of us using that one sink all day.

Tenant says two power points in the lounge have stopped working and only one light comes on down the hallway. She reports eight people are living in the three-bedroom house, two of them babies, so everything is being run off the one point in the kitchen.
The drain outside the laundry running real slow. Water just sit there and take long time to go down. Been like this a couple of weeks now, no rush but someone can have a look.
No water out of any tap since this morning, nothing at all. We got a newborn here and no way to wash bottles or make up her feeds.

Tenant says the hot water system is leaking underneath and the shower pressure has dropped right off. She reports the house faces west and only has fans, so it gets very hot of an afternoon and they are needing water to keep cool.

The toilet backed up a couple of nights ago and now it will not flush at all. Waste is coming up through the shower drain so we cannot use the bathroom or wash. My old dad lives here with me and he should not be going outside in the dark. The road in is open for now but it cuts out once the rain really sets in.

The bathroom tap came off in my hand when I turned it and now it only dribbles. We have been washing the little one in the kitchen sink instead. I am seven months pregnant and bending over that sink is hard going. Be good if a crew can get out before the road turns boggy.
Hot water gone, only lukewarm coming through now. One of the adults here goes in for dialysis three days a week and needs a proper wash when he gets back. Road is still good if someone can come soon.
Toilet overflows onto the bathroom floor every time I flush it. I'm in my seventies and on my own here, can't be mopping that up all day.

The ceiling in the back bedroom has pulled away from the wall and there is a big sag in the middle of it. There are eleven of us here across three generations in a three-bedroom house, so that room is slept in every night. My old mum is in the front room and the babies sleep in the back one with their mum. We have shut the door on it but there is nowhere else to put everyone.

The laundry drain backs up every time we run the washing machine. It clears itself after a while but the smell sits in there. We do a lot of washing because our son needs help with everything each day. There is no road in here so a crew would have to come on the barge or fly.

Tenant says the power keeps tripping and half the house has no lights, including the hallway through to the bathroom. He reports he is an older man who does not get around easily, and being in the dark at night is a worry for him. Asks for someone to come out as soon as they can.
The oven not heating proper anymore, only the top element working. I can still use the stove top but anything I put in the oven come out half cooked. No rush on it, whenever someone in the area.
Pipe has burst under the kitchen sink, water going everywhere. Had to shut the whole house off at the mains so now we got no water at all, no toilet, nothing.

Tenant says the flyscreens on three windows are torn through and the back door screen will not shut. She reports eight people live in the three-bedroom house including two babies, and the mozzies are in the bedrooms all night. Notes there is no road in, so the materials will need to come over on the barge.
Aircon in the lounge only blowing warm air. House cooks by the afternoon and the kids can't sit inside to do anything. No road here, crew has to come by barge or plane.

The back door has dropped in the frame and the lock will not catch at all now. It swings open on its own if the wind comes up, so we cannot lock the house. We are both in our eighties and neither of us is sleeping much with it like that. Road is still open at the moment if a crew can get out this way.

Tenant says the stove has stopped working apart from one hotplate that still heats. She reports there are six in the house and one adult with kidney disease who needs his meals cooked at home. Asks for a repair next time a crew is around this way.

The sewer has blocked up somewhere out the back and nothing drains from the toilet or the shower. It started yesterday afternoon and has not cleared one bit since. We shut the water off to stop it coming up through the floor waste, so there is no toilet and no washing in the house now. Our son needs help with everything each day and we cannot look after him properly without a bathroom.

Power been going off and on all morning, and when it come back there was a bang from the powerpoint near the kitchen and a burnt smell. We turned everything off at the box so there is no power in the house now. This house got a tin roof and no trees for shade, so inside gets that hot we can't stop in there the middle of the day. Road is still open but it get cut when the rain come.

Tenant rang this morning about cockroaches through the kitchen cupboards and under the sink, and she says there is mouse droppings on the bench as well. She has newborn twins and a four-year-old in the house and does not want them crawling about where the roaches are. Nothing is broken, she would just like someone out to treat the place.

The handle on the back door come loose about a fortnight ago and now the latch will not catch at all. We have been putting a chair against it at night so it stays shut. Our youngest is eighteen months and she can push that door open and get outside on her own. It needs a new handle and lock when a crew is next this way.

Tenant phoned to say the air conditioner in the main room has stopped blowing cold, it only rattles and pushes warm air around. She reports it went that way two nights back and the house has not cooled down since. Asked for a crew as soon as one can get out; the sealed road is fine for a vehicle.
Clothesline has pulled out of the ground, whole thing lying on its side. Can't hang washing, and with my condition I am not able to lift it back up myself.

The fan in the ceiling of the bedroom been making a clicking noise and now it only turn on the slow speed. Aircon in the lounge is still going alright so this one can wait till a crew is out this way. Just wanting it looked at before the wet, because when that road shut nothing get in.

Couple of sheets of roofing iron on the back part come loose and they lift up and bang when the wind blow. No water coming in yet but you can see daylight through one spot in the corner. There is seven of us in this house, three generations, and that back room is where the little ones sleep so we shifted them into the front. Better to fix it before the big rains and before the road gets cut.
Gutter has come away from the roof over the carport and it is hanging down. Not game to get up a ladder with my health the way it is, and the wheelchair makes it no good anyway.

The tap in the laundry been dripping for weeks and now it drip even when you turn it hard. My hands not strong any more, I am getting on in years and I can't twist it off proper. Water is going all over the laundry floor. Can someone come and put a new washer in it.

Something wrong with the power in the front room, the light been flickering and then sparks come out of the wall switch and it went black round it. We smelt burning so we shut the power off at the meter box. I am an old lady and I don't want to be touching none of it. Please send someone quick, the whole house got no power now.
Ants everywhere in the kitchen, big trails from the window along the bench. New baby in the house and I am sick of them getting into the bottles and the nappy bin.
Aircon in the bedroom drips water onto the floor and the remote will not change the temperature. Not desperate about it, but next time a crew comes over on the barge could they have a look.

Tenant came in to report that half the powerpoints in the house have gone dead, including the ones the fans run off in the lounge and the bedroom. She says the house faces west and cops the afternoon sun, and with only fans for cooling they cannot sit inside once it heats up. Asked whether a crew could come in on the next plane rather than waiting on the barge.
Front door lock is busted, key just spins and the door will not lock at all. One of us is on dialysis three days a week and the house sits empty while we are gone, so we need it seen to soon.

Tenant called to say there is no water at all coming out of any tap in the house since last night, and the toilet will not flush. She reports the family cannot wash or cook and have been carrying drinking water from a neighbour. Asked for a plumber today.

The safety switch started tripping a few nights ago and now it goes every time the fridge kicks in. We have no power to the kitchen or the bathroom unless we unplug the fridge and reset it. I am seven months pregnant and we have a toddler here, so losing the fridge and the bathroom light is really hard going. There is no road in, so it would have to be someone coming on the plane.

The drain outside the bathroom has backed up and sewage is coming up onto the ground by the back step. It started yesterday afternoon and it has spread across the path we use to get to the laundry. My partner has bad asthma and the smell coming through the window sets their chest off. We have shut the window and stopped using the shower until someone comes.

The hot water in the shower has gone funny over the last week, it runs hot, goes cold for a minute, then comes back. The kitchen tap does the same thing. Bathing a toddler is a job when the water keeps changing on you, and being seven months pregnant I would rather not be standing there fiddling with taps. No rush on it, but it needs looking at.

Tenant is deaf and wrote this down for me here at the office. They say the toilet is blocked and water comes up over the rim of the bowl when it is flushed, and the floor of the toilet room is wet. There is only the one toilet in the house, so a plumber is needed quickly; the sealed road is open.
Stove has stopped working, no heat on any of the plates and the oven is dead too. Can't warm anything for the baby and the shop is a long way, so we need it fixed before that road closes.

Two of the hotplates on the stove not working now, only the one still heats up. Been cooking for five of us on that one plate and it takes forever. House gets real hot under the tin roof with no trees round it, and standing over the stove that long makes it worse. Not an emergency but we need it sorted.

Tenant rang to say the power points in the back bedroom have stopped working and she is running a lead in from the lounge. She is pregnant and says having the lead across the floor worries her. No sparks or burning smell, she just wants a sparky out when one is next through.

The front door lock busted this morning and now the door don't stay shut, it just swings open. We been putting a chair against it of a night. Can someone come and fix the lock soon, before the rain shuts the road in.
Aircon packed up yesterday arvo, blowing warm air only. Nothing cold coming out of it at all.

The drain outside the laundry started backing up about a week ago and now there is water sitting in the yard. It smells when the sun hits it. My cousin is staying with us while she gets over her operation and she has to walk past it to the clothesline. The kids are keeping away from it but we would like it looked at.

The aircon stopped working last night and the house is not cooling down at all. We got five kids here and the baby not even one yet, she was crying most of the night. There is seven of us in the house and only the one fan still going. Can someone come and look at it soon.

A storm came through the other night and lifted some of the roof sheeting over the back bedroom. Water came in through the ceiling and the stain is spreading. My brother is staying with us while he recovers from his operation and that is the room he was sleeping in, so we have shifted him onto the couch. It needs patching before the next lot of rain.

The pipe under the kitchen sink let go yesterday and we had to turn the water off at the meter to stop it flooding. That means no water in the house at all now, no tap, no shower, no flushing the toilet. My dad is in his eighties and he can't be carting buckets about. We are getting drinking water off the neighbour but we can't keep doing that.
Oven door won't shut properly, hangs open a bit and all the heat gets out. Hotplates still fine.

We noticed the ceiling in the hallway sagging after the rain last week and it has got worse since. Water drips through when it rains hard and we have a bucket under it. My husband and I are both in our eighties and neither of us can get up there to have a look. We would rather it was seen to before the whole lot comes down.
Powerpoint in the back room sparked when I plugged the fan in, black mark on the wall now. Got a newborn sleeping in there.

Half the roof come off the back of the house in the blow last night and you can see sky from the kitchen. Rain is coming straight in and the ceiling is dropping down in bits. There is seven of us living here, grandparents and all, and we are all crowded in the front room now. Nothing due in by barge for a bit so we don't know how the sheets get out here.

Tenant phoned to report smoke coming out of the switchboard and a burning smell through the house. Tenant has shut the power off at the main and the house has no power now. Tenant only moved in last month and will not sleep there until someone has checked it.

The hot water system split open at the bottom and the whole lot ran out under the house. We turned the mains off to stop it and now nothing comes out of any tap. We are both in our eighties and have been washing out of a kettle of bottled water since. The road in is sealed so a truck can get here any day.

Tenant reports that half the house lost power two nights ago and the circuit trips again every time it is reset. One adult in the household is on dialysis and needs the fridge for medication as well as the machine running overnight. Tenant asks for a sparky on the next plane in.
Flyscreen door won't latch, keeps blowing open. House cooks of an afternoon so we leave the back door open for a breeze, can't do that with the screen like this.

The bathroom tap been dripping a few weeks and now the cold one won't turn off all the way. Water running down the wall behind it too. My partner got diabetes and washes a fair bit, and we got a two year old in the bath every night. No rush, just put it on the list for when the barge comes.

The light in the bathroom stopped working about a fortnight back and a new globe made no difference. The switch clicks but nothing happens. My mother is elderly and she uses that room through the night, so we have left a torch in there for now. Whenever a sparky is next out this way would be fine.

Tenant rang about cockroaches through the kitchen cupboards and geckos getting in where the flyscreen has torn. The house faces west and gets very hot of an afternoon, so they keep the windows open for air and that is when the insects come in. Tenant asks for pest control and the screen mended when someone is next out.

Tenant reports the toilet is blocked and water came over the rim onto the bathroom floor when it was flushed. The cistern keeps filling so the tenant has turned the tap behind it off. Tenant is deaf, so please contact this office to arrange a time rather than ringing the house.

The tap over the laundry tub started dripping about a fortnight ago and now it runs a steady stream no matter how hard we turn it off. There is eleven of us in a three bedroom house so that tub is going all day, washing the baby's things and everybody else's. My old dad has to walk through the puddle to get out to the clothesline. Road is alright now but it gets cut in the wet, so better someone looks at it before then.

Tenant rang first thing this morning to say the front door will not lock at all, the barrel spins free and the door swings open on its own. She and her husband are both elderly and they have three little grandkids under six staying with them, and she says she sat up most of the night. Asks for someone out today if a crew can be spared, we are only a short run from the depot.

Tenant phoned to report water pouring out under the kitchen sink since last night, he says the cupboard is full of it and it is running across the floor. He is an older fella living on his own and cannot get down in there to shut the tap off himself. He has towels down and asks for a plumber while the road is still open.

Sewer backed up in the bathroom, coming up out of the shower drain, whole floor wet and smelling bad. Can't use the toilet at all now, and it's just me, an old lady, with two little grandkids, youngest only four.

The toilet cistern he keep running all the time, never stop filling up. Seven of us living here, three generations, so that toilet get used plenty and the noise go all night. Nothing flooding, just running and running. Can someone have a look when they round this way.

There has been no hot water since yesterday morning. I had a look at the unit outside and the pilot light is out, I tried lighting it again and it will not stay on. My mum is elderly and she lives here with me, and she will not wash at all in a cold shower. Can someone come and get it going, please.
Cockroaches all through the kitchen cupboards and something chewing into the flour bags. Been getting worse the last few weeks, can wait till there is someone coming over on the barge anyway.

Tenant came in to the office this morning and we wrote this down together, as he is deaf. He reports the toilet will not flush and waste water is coming up out of the drain in the yard, so there is nowhere in the house he can use. He is asking for a crew out while the road is dry.

Tenant reports the back screen door has come off its top hinge and the key will not turn in the deadlock any more. She says her husband has kidney disease and goes in and out that way for his dialysis runs, so she would like the door closing properly again. No hurry, they are pulling it shut with a bit of rope for now.
Bathroom tap won't turn off the whole way, drips into the basin all night. Just me here and I'm in my seventies, so no rush, but it's wasting good water.
Clothesline post has come loose out the back and the whole line is sagging down in the dirt, washing can't dry on it. Whenever a crew is next flying in is fine by us.

Tenant says two sheets of roof iron over the verandah have lifted and are rattling about in the wind. He is an older man on his own and cannot get up to look, so he is going off what he can see from the ground. Nothing coming in inside yet, he asks that it be booked for the next crew coming through on the barge or the plane.

Tenant rang to say the drain outside the laundry is overflowing and dirty water is running back in under the house. She reports one of the adults in the house has kidney disease and has to keep things clean around him, and with six of them home it is getting worse by the hour. She is asking for a crew today.

Tenant reports mice in the kitchen and in the children's bedroom, droppings along the bench every morning. She says there are eight of them in a three bedroom house, two of them babies who are crawling round on the floor, so she has been keeping all the food up high. Happy to wait for an ordinary booking.
Big leak through the bedroom ceiling, the plaster has gone soft and it's sagging down with all this rain. Water's coming in faster than I can bucket it out.

Tenant reports half the power points in the house are dead and the safety switch trips every time the kettle goes on. She says her brother has kidney disease and the house needs the fridge and the fans running for him, so she cannot be sitting here with no power. Road is open at the moment if a sparky can get out before the rain sets in.

No water coming out of any tap since yesterday, not the kitchen one, not the shower. My daughter she went and checked the tap outside too, nothing there either. I'm an old woman and I can't be carrying buckets from next door every day. Road is sealed so please send someone quick.

The air conditioner in the lounge is blowing but the air isn't cold any more, started about a week back. I took the filter out and washed it and that made no difference at all. The house gets stuffy of an afternoon with this build up. It can wait for an ordinary job, we're close in to the depot anyway.
Water pipe burst under the house, no water in any of the taps now. A houseful of us here with family staying for the season and nothing to wash or cook with, and the road out is rough going.

Stove not working at all now, no gas coming through to the burners or the oven. Seven of us in this house, three generations, and we can't cook a feed for everybody. We been making a little fire outside but that no good in this rain. Need someone come and look at it quick.

The aircon in the lounge stopped blowing cold about a week ago. It still runs but the air coming out is warm and it drips onto the floor. We have been getting by with fans at night. Could someone come and have a look at it when they get a chance?

Two of the hotplates on the stove have stopped heating up, only the small one still works. It has been like that since the weekend. I look after my elderly mum here and cook her meals every day, so we are making do with the microwave for now. No rush, but we would like it looked at.

Tenant says the oven has stopped heating and the door will not stay shut, though the hotplates still work. She reports one adult in the house has kidney disease and needs meals cooked at home on a special diet.

A patch of the hallway ceiling has started to sag and go brown, and I reckon water is getting in through the roof. It only shows up after heavy rain. Nothing has come down yet but it looks worse than it did a fortnight ago. We all work during the day so afternoons suit best for a visit.

Tenant rang to say the air conditioner in the main bedroom has packed up and is only pushing out warm air. She says she has newborn twins and a four year old at home and that room gets very stuffy through the day. She asks for a call before the crew drives out, in case the road in is shut.

The tap over the kitchen sink has been dripping for a couple of weeks and now the pipe under it is leaking too, so there is a bucket sitting under there. The shower pressure has dropped off as well. I am seven months pregnant and bending down to empty that bucket with a toddler under my feet is getting hard. Whenever the crew is next out this way, could they put us on the list?

Aircon in my room not working now, only blowing hot air out. It been like this since the wet started. I'm getting old and the sleep is no good when the room stay warm all night. My daughter she ring the office already but nobody come yet.

The toilet cistern he keep running all the time, water just going and going. The laundry tap is dripping too since last week. Nothing flooding, but we don't like wasting that water. Maybe the plumber can bring the parts next time the barge come.

The front door lock has gone dodgy. The key turns but the latch does not catch, so the door swings open on its own. One of the flyscreens has also come off its track and will not shut. We are all out at work most of the day and would rather not leave it like that, but we are happy to wait until someone is coming through anyway.

The shower only trickle now, hardly any water coming out of it. We got seven people living here, three generations, all sharing that one bathroom, so it take all morning to get everyone washed. The kitchen tap he slow too. Can someone come and look when the road is open.
Power points in the kitchen sparked and went dead, burning smell coming out of the wall. That whole side of the house has no power now, I come home off night shift and it is black.

Half the house got no power since last night, and the switch keep tripping every time we put it back on. The fridge and all the fans are dead. This house got a tin roof and no trees, so inside it like an oven of an afternoon and the kids come home from school to that. We need the sparky out quick smart.
Sewage backing up through the shower drain and the back yard is wet and stinking. Cannot use the toilet without it coming up inside the house.

Tenant reports the switchboard keeps tripping and most of the house has had no power since yesterday, including the fridge. She says there are eight people in the three bedroom house, two of them babies, and she has no way to keep their milk cold. The road in is open at the moment but she says it will not be after the next big rain.

The aircon in the bedroom it stopped cooling, just making noise and blowing warm air. My wife she pregnant, the baby coming soon, and she can't sleep in that hot room. We put a fan in there but it not much help. Can you put us down for when the crew come out this way.

The toilet he blocked right up and dirty water coming back through the laundry drain, so we got no toilet working in the house at all. We been walking over to the neighbour place to use theirs. This house got a tin roof and no shade tree, and with that smell we can't even open the windows in the heat. Please fix it before the road go under.

The hot water system stopped working sometime over the weekend and there is no hot water at any of the taps now. I had a look and there is a bit of water pooled under the tank. Showers are cold but we are coping. Could a plumber take a look next time one is out here?

The back screen door has come off one hinge and will not close, so flies and mozzies are getting in all day. It happened when the wind came through last week. We have a relative staying with us who is recovering from an operation and resting in that back room. Not an emergency, but we would like it sorted.

Water pipe burst under the house and now nothing coming out of the taps, no water for washing and none for the toilet. I'm an old man and my heart is no good, so carting buckets from up the road is too much for me. Someone need to come quick, before that road go under with the rain.
Drains backed up, waste water coming up through the bathroom floor and spreading across the room. My partner uses a wheelchair and cannot get in there now without going through it.

Tenant phoned to say the air conditioner in the lounge only blows warm air now, and it has been like that about a week. She reports she has newborn twins and a four year old at home, and is running fans in the meantime. Asked for it to be looked at when a crew is next around.

Two of the hotplates on the stove not working no more, only the little one heats up. We got nine people living in this house, two of them little ones under five, so cooking for everyone takes long time now. Everything come in by barge or plane out here, so maybe send the part with the next one.

Last night the powerpoints in the kitchen stopped working and there was a burning smell from the one by the fridge. I switched the power off at the board and have left it off since. My father lives here with me, he is an old man and he needs a light on to get to the toilet at night. The road in is open at the moment but it goes to mud once the rain sets in.
Front door lock has broken, door won't lock at all now. Can't leave the place shut properly and my partner is in a wheelchair, so that door is the only way she gets in and out.

Turned the stove on yesterday evening and there was a spark and a pop from the back element, then the whole thing went dead. There is a burnt smell around the switch and we have not touched it since. My wife and I are both in our eighties and that stove is the only way we cook a meal. Twenty five years in this house and it has never done that before.

The hot water been going cold halfway through the shower for a couple weeks now. We got a two year old to wash, and I got diabetes so I need to keep my feet clean and check them proper. No road out here, everything come by barge or plane, so no rush, just put us down on the list.

Pipe under the kitchen sink burst this morning. Had to shut the water off at the main so there is nothing running in the house at all now, and it is just me and my two grandkids here, the youngest one is four and I am getting on in years myself.

The oven door don't shut properly no more, it drops open while the food is still cooking. Cooktop is working alright so we been managing with that. Our first baby is due next month so it would be good to have it right before then.
No hot water at all since yesterday, the unit outside is leaking and making a racket. I work nights so any time through the day suits, and the road is still dry if someone comes soon.
Oven has stopped heating, cooktop still alright. One of us is on dialysis three days a week and needs proper food cooked, so whenever a crew is next out this way would do us.

Water pipe out the front broke sometime in the night and now we got no water coming to the taps or the toilet. Toilet won't flush and we can't wash or cook. I am having my first baby next month so this one is hard for us. Road in is alright at the moment but the rain been coming most afternoons.

The air conditioner stopped altogether two nights ago, no air coming out and it clicks when you switch it on. We tried the switch at the board and it made no difference. There are four of us here and we all work, so someone can let a crew in after knock off or on a weekend. The track in is still passable but that will change once the wet really starts.

The hot water system packed it in a few days back, there is water pooling underneath it and every tap runs cold. We have a relative staying while she recovers from an operation, and she needs warm water to wash and keep her dressings clean. The rest of the house has been putting up with cold showers. The road out here is sealed so a crew should get in with no trouble.

Tenant rang this morning to report sewage backing up into the shower and a strong smell right through the house. He says it started overnight and the ground out the back is wet around the drain. He is an older man living on his own who does not get about well, and he notes the road in is open now but will not stay that way once the rain comes.

Only one hotplate working on the stove, the other three do nothing when you turn them on. Not in a hurry about it, but I am an old fella here on my own and it would be good to cook a proper feed again.

My stove not working proper, only one burner come on and then it go out again. I'm getting on in years and I can't be carrying pots over to the neighbour's place for every meal. My daughter working most days so it just me here.

No water in the house since yesterday, taps dry and the toilet won't flush. One of us is on dialysis three days a week and has to keep clean and drink plenty, can't do that with nothing coming out.

The aircon in my room making a loud rattle and it not blowing like it used to. Still goes a bit but it getting worse every week. I work at the store so any time after knock off suits me.

Only the front room aircon working, the one in the kids room just blow warm air. It get real hot in the house of an afternoon and the little two year old don't sleep at all. I got diabetes and the heat knock me round a fair bit too. We not far from the crew base so hopefully someone can swing by.

Laundry drain running slow and there's a smell out the back where it pools. Baby's only a few weeks old so I'd rather not have it sitting like that, and the road in might close once the rain sets in.

Two of the burners on the stove not working now, only the small one still lights up. Hard to cook proper food for the little one, she only two years old. I got diabetes and I need to eat regular, so this making things difficult. Can you send someone round to fix the stove.

Laundry tap dripping nonstop and the cold line out the back is leaking into the dirt. House cooks by mid afternoon in this build up and we're going through water just trying to stay cool, so would be good to get it sorted.

The main water pipe out the front burst and the tap had to be shut off, so we've had no water in the house since yesterday morning. There are eleven of us living here across three bedrooms, including my old mum and a baby, and we're carting drinking water from the neighbours. No one can shower and the toilet won't flush. The road in is dirt and already getting boggy, so please get someone out while it's still open.

The aircon unit in the back bedroom has stopped cooling, it rattles away and only blows warm air. The deadbolt snapped off in the front door lock last night and the door won't sit shut now, it swings in with the wind. Toilet won't flush and the drain out the back is bubbling sewage up into the yard. Smell is right through the house. Rain's been making the road boggy too.

Cockroaches all through the kitchen cupboards and mouse droppings behind the fridge. We've got a new baby in the house so we'd rather not have them about, no rush though, whenever a crew's coming this way.

There was a bang in the laundry this morning and the switchboard tripped. I put it back on and it tripped straight away again, and now there's a black mark around the socket. Nobody's going in that room until it's sorted. It needs looking at today.

The main water pipe under the house split yesterday and there's nothing coming out of any tap now. We can't wash, can't flush the toilet, and we're down to what's in the fridge to drink. Aircon quit on me last night, no air coming out at all, just a clicking when I switch him on. Couldn't sleep and the place won't cool down even with all the windows open. Need someone quick as.

No power in half the house since last night, sparks came out of the board in the hallway. Nine of us staying here with family down for the season, all sharing the one fridge and the one plug that still works.

Hot water system is leaking out the bottom and the shower pressure has dropped right off. Ten of us in the house with family staying, so we can't go long without washing.

There's a gap opening up where the roof meet the wall in the back room, you can see daylight through it. No rain coming in yet but the wet is here so it probably will. Seven of us living here, three generations, so that back room always got someone sleeping in it.

Hot water system only giving us cold water now, been like that since the weekend. There is nine of us living here so there is washing going all the time, and the two little ones under five need a warm bath at night. We boiling the kettle for them but that takes ages.

Air con runs all day but it only blowing warm air now. My missus has diabetes and she don't do well when the house stays warm, and our little boy is two so he don't settle either. Road is alright at the moment, no big hurry, whenever a crew comes out this way.
